# Careers at ACME

We hire engineers, designers and support staff in Hanoi and Singapore.

## Benefits

Every employee gets 12 days of annual leave, private health insurance and a learning budget.

- Lunch allowance of 730,000 VND per month
- Parking or transport support
  - 150,000 VND for parking
- A laptop of your choice
